764:t_1:3.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Briefing Room～

764:t_1:4.en:
$$ブルー$$
「...This is the first time we've met face to face. Allow me to introduce myself properly.」

764:t_1:5.en:
$$ブルー$$
「I am Code: $$ブルー$$. I currently serve as acting field commander of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists.」

764:t_1:7.en:
$$ブルー$$
「The members of our organization address one another by code names.」

764:t_1:8.en:
$$ブルー$$
「Now that Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ is dead, I command the Reformists' operational forces.」

764:t_1:9.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Thank you for your cooperation during the 《$$時獄戦役$$》.」

764:t_1:10.en:
$$ブルー$$
「No... As our captain said, victory was only possible thanks to your efforts. We merely supported you.」

764:t_1:11.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It's been about two and a half months since the $$時獄戦役$$... What have you been doing in that time?」

764:t_1:12.en:
$$ブルー$$
「As I said at the final battle with $$ジェミニス$$, we were working to defeat the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives manipulating the $$地球連邦$$ from the shadows, but...」

764:t_1:13.en:
$$ブルー$$
「They escaped us in the chaos of the $$サイデリアル$$ invasion.」

764:t_1:14.en:
$$オットー$$
「And today, you'll tell us everything about $$クロノ$$, won't you?」

764:t_1:15.en:
$$ブルー$$
「I am sorry, but I cannot do that.」

764:t_1:16.en:
$$オットー$$
「Why? You said back then that you would tell us once it was all over.」

764:t_1:17.en:
$$ブルー$$
「Speaking about $$クロノ$$ would also reveal its doctrine... That is the reason.」

764:t_1:18.en:
$$テッサ$$
「A doctrine... Teachings that must be upheld...」

764:t_1:19.en:
$$テッサ$$
「So those who uphold it are the Conservatives, while you are trying to change it.」

764:t_1:20.en:
$$ブルー$$
「Exactly. That is why we are forbidden to reveal it to outsiders like you.」

764:t_1:21.en:
$$ブルー$$
「Only when we have utterly defeated the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives and rendered that doctrine meaningless can we bring it into the light.」

764:t_1:23.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Now that I understand your circumstances, I won't force the issue.」

764:t_1:24.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But under that doctrine, the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives manipulated the Federation and tried to oppress the Spacenoids.」

764:t_1:25.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I also hear they were involved in the assassinations of 《$$ジオン・ダイクン$$》 and 《$$ＡＤＷ$$》's 《$$ヒイロ・ユイ#keyword$$》.」

764:t_1:26.en:
$$オットー$$
「So $$クロノ$$ existed across parallel worlds...?」

764:t_1:27.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Or similar organizations existed in each world...」

764:t_1:28.en:
$$ブルー$$
「Many of those questions will be answered once the doctrine is revealed.」

764:t_1:29.en:
$$オットー$$
「So you won't tell us, no matter what?」

764:t_1:31.en:
$$オットー$$
「...I understand. We will wait for that day.」

764:t_1:32.en:
$$オットー$$
「Dealing with our current situation is more pressing for us as well.」

764:t_1:33.en:
$$ブルー$$
「I am sorry. But you can be certain that we are your allies.」

764:t_1:34.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Why did you appear where we were transported? We cannot dismiss that as coincidence.」

764:t_1:35.en:
$$ブルー$$
「If you dislike the word 'coincidence,' how about 'fate'?」

764:t_1:37.en:
$$ブルー$$
「I was ordered by our superiors to stand by in this area, but I was not told that you would be coming.」

764:t_1:39.en:
$$ブルー$$
「Yes. We are merely an operational force; they decide our course of action.」

764:t_1:40.en:
$$ブルー$$
「Contacting you was also their order.」

764:t_1:41.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then... what exactly do you want from us?」

764:t_1:42.en:
$$ブルー$$
「At present, our foremost mission is to overthrow the $$新地球皇国$$.」

764:t_1:43.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Your organization, whose purpose is to watch over humanity's evolution?」

764:t_1:44.en:
$$ブルー$$
「They intend to exploit our Earth... what you call $$蒼の地球$$.」

764:t_1:45.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Extracting $$次元力$$ through the $$レイライン$$s...」

764:t_1:46.en:
$$ブルー$$
「Exactly. Leaving them unchecked is tantamount to turning Earth, our mother planet, into a dead world.」

764:t_1:47.en:
$$ブルー$$
「We cannot hand them the Earth Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ gave his life to protect.」

764:t_1:49.en:
$$オットー$$
「But the fact is, $$サイデリアル$$ is enormously powerful. Defeating it with the depleted Federation forces and their disrupted command structure would be extremely difficult.」

764:t_1:50.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$c has also been forced to scatter its forces. We cannot attempt a breakthrough at a single point.」

764:t_1:51.en:
$$ブルー$$
「If $$蒼の地球$$'s forces alone cannot stand against them, why not seek reinforcements elsewhere?」

764:t_1:54.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$ブルー$$... Do you know what the situation is like on that planet?」

764:t_1:55.en:
$$ブルー$$
「Yes... We have already landed on $$翠の地球$$ several times.」

764:t_1:56.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「You managed that while $$サイデリアル$$ controls space...?」

764:t_1:57.en:
$$ブルー$$
「...No. Our visits to $$翠の地球$$ were during the $$時獄戦役$$.」

764:t_1:59.en:
$$オットー$$
「You broke through the $$時の牢獄$$!?」

764:t_1:60.en:
$$ブルー$$
「Only under limited conditions, but the power of Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s $$アスクレプス$$ made it possible.」

764:t_1:61.en:
$$オットー$$
「I had no idea that happened...」

764:t_1:62.en:
$$テッサ$$
(That machine was different even from the ones equipped with $$スフィア$$s... Just how much power did it have...?)

764:t_1:63.en:
$$ブルー$$
「As you know, $$サイデリアル$$ used $$翠の地球$$ as a forward base to invade $$蒼の地球$$.」

764:t_1:64.en:
$$ブルー$$
「And forces on $$翠の地球$$ are still fighting to resist $$サイデリアル$$, just as you are.」

764:t_1:65.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So we would form a united front with them...」

764:t_1:66.en:
$$ブルー$$
「$$サイデリアル$$'s main forces are in the process of moving from $$翠の地球$$ to $$蒼の地球$$.」

764:t_1:67.en:
$$ブルー$$
「If you add your strength to the local forces, liberating $$翠の地球$$ should be possible.」

764:t_1:68.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then we would ask for their help in reclaiming $$蒼の地球$$...」

764:t_1:69.en:
$$ブルー$$
「On $$翠の地球$$, I worked alongside people who know you.」

764:t_1:71.en:
$$ブルー$$
「$$セツコ・オハラ$$, $$ランド・トラビス$$, $$クロウ・ブルースト$$...」

764:t_1:72.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So they were on $$翠の地球$$.」

764:t_1:73.en:
$$オットー$$
「Those three are... if I recall correctly...」

764:t_1:74.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes. They are 《$$スフィア・リアクター$$》s who fought with $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$.」

764:t_1:75.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「If we can join up with them, they will be a tremendous asset.」

764:t_1:77.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But if we head for $$翠の地球$$, that will weaken our front on $$蒼の地球$$.」

764:t_1:78.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I propose we divide our forces in two to address that.」

764:t_1:79.en:
$$オットー$$
「Then the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ will remain on $$蒼の地球$$. We must also report the situation to Commander $$ブライト$$.」

764:t_1:80.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「In that case, the $$マクロス・クォーター$$ and $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ will head for $$翠の地球$$.」

764:t_1:81.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The $$翠の地球$$ force will comprise $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$ミスリル$$, $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$, $$鉄人$$, $$オックス$$, and the $$マジンガーチーム$$.」

764:t_1:82.en:
$$オットー$$
「Then let us assign the mobile suits to the force remaining on $$蒼の地球$$.」

notes: Blue speaks formally to the three captains. Chrono doctrine remains undisclosed; Tessa infers the faction distinction. Heero in the assassination keyword link is #keyword, not the living pilot.
